evidence.title: Fairness-Aware Mixture-of-Experts via Subgroup Reweighting and Gate Regularization

summary: Researchers introduce a fairness-aware approach for Mixture-of-Experts models, combining subgroup reweighting and gate regularization to reduce bias. The method aims to improve equitable performance across diverse demographic groups.
title: New AI Technique Enhances Fairness in Mixture-of-Experts Models
